_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Vanuatu.

910.name: Early Human Settlement
910.description: Lapita and subsequent Melanesian settlement of the Vanuatu archipelago.

sub_clusters.name: Lapita Settlement
sub_clusters.description: Teouma Lapita cemetery on Efate; earliest known Lapita burial site.

sub_clusters.name: Post-Lapita Cultural Development
sub_clusters.description: Pottery abandonment; development of diverse Melanesian cultures across 80 islands.

920.name: Pre-Contact Vanuatu Societies
920.description: Kastom traditions; grade-taking systems; nakamal meeting houses.

sub_clusters.name: Grade-Taking System (Nimangki)
sub_clusters.description: Complex ritual status system; pig-killing ceremonies; ranked society.

sub_clusters.name: Land Diving (Naghol) — Pentecost Island
sub_clusters.description: Ritual tower jumping with vine ropes; origin of bungee jumping concept.

930.name: European Contact
930.description: Spanish discovery; Cook's voyages; missionaries and sandalwood traders.

sub_clusters.name: Quirós Expedition
sub_clusters.description: Pedro Fernández de Quirós names Espiritu Santo; first European contact.

sub_clusters.name: Cook Names New Hebrides
sub_clusters.description: James Cook charts and names the archipelago; Tanna encounters.

sub_clusters.name: Sandalwood Trade and Blackbirding
sub_clusters.description: Resource extraction; coerced labour trade to Queensland and Fiji.

940.name: Anglo-French Condominium
940.description: Unique dual colonial administration by Britain and France; 'Pandemonium'.

sub_clusters.name: Joint Naval Commission and Condominium
sub_clusters.description: Competing colonial claims resolved by joint governance framework.

sub_clusters.name: Condominium Governance
sub_clusters.description: Dual legal systems, police forces, schools; French and English tracks.

950.name: World War II in Vanuatu
950.description: Major US military base at Espiritu Santo; transformative wartime experience.

sub_clusters.name: US Base at Espiritu Santo
sub_clusters.description: 500,000 US troops pass through; massive infrastructure; Million Dollar Point.

sub_clusters.name: Wartime Cultural Impact
sub_clusters.description: Ni-Vanuatu encounter racial equality, modern goods; seeds of independence thinking.

950.name: John Frum and Cargo Cults
950.description: Cargo cult movements on Tanna; resistance to colonial authority.

sub_clusters.name: John Frum Movement
sub_clusters.description: Prophetic movement rejecting missionaries; awaiting return of American goods.

sub_clusters.name: Prince Philip Movement
sub_clusters.description: Yaohnanen village on Tanna venerate Prince Philip as divine figure.

950.name: Independence Movement
950.description: New Hebrides National Party; Santo Rebellion; independence.

sub_clusters.name: Nagriamel Movement
sub_clusters.description: Jimmy Stevens' land rights movement; evolves into secessionist rebellion.

sub_clusters.name: Santo Rebellion (Coconut War)
sub_clusters.description: Secessionist revolt on Espiritu Santo; PNG troops restore order.

sub_clusters.name: Vanuatu Independence (1980)
sub_clusters.description: Independence 30 July 1980; Walter Lini first PM.

960.name: Contemporary Vanuatu
960.description: Kastom preservation; climate vulnerability; Cyclone Pam; geopolitical positioning.

sub_clusters.name: Cyclone Pam (2015)
sub_clusters.description: Category 5 cyclone devastates Vanuatu; 90% structures damaged on some islands.

sub_clusters.name: Climate Change Advocacy
sub_clusters.description: ICJ advisory opinion campaign; loss and damage advocacy; existential threat.

sub_clusters.name: Kastom Cultural Preservation
sub_clusters.description: Vanuatu Cultural Centre; fieldworkers program; living traditions.
